_readme: Posture routine: 13 steps, 9 minutes, played back to back. Built from two Jeremy Ethier (Built With Science) videos: 'The PERFECT 10 Minute Daily Posture Routine (FIX YOUR SIT!)' (youtube.com/watch?v=RqcOCBb4arc) and 'PERFECT Posture Routine To Unlock Your Sh*t (10 Min/Day)' (youtube.com/watch?v=XWQvmh_INTQ). Timings follow the second video's on-screen table (1 minute, or 30 seconds each side); the first video's rep-based moves are fitted to the same blocks. Mobility first, strengthening after, glute bridge last, as both videos say. He recommends doing it at least twice a day. 'cue' is shown under the timer.

movements.name: Over-and-backs
movements.cue: Band or towel, wide grip, arms straight. Sweep it overhead and behind you, then back. Brace so your lower back does not arch.

movements.name: Cobra
movements.cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Lift your chest with your back, not your arms. Pause and breathe at the top. 5 to 10 slow reps.

movements.name: Stand and reach · left
movements.cue: Right hand on your hip. Reach your left arm up and diagonally back. Hold 5 to 10 seconds, release, repeat.

movements.name: Stand and reach · right
movements.cue: Left hand on your hip. Reach your right arm up and diagonally back. Do extra reps on the side that feels tighter.

movements.name: Back rotations · left
movements.cue: On all fours, left hand behind your neck. Thread the elbow under, then rotate it up to the ceiling. Eyes follow the elbow.

movements.name: Back rotations · right
movements.cue: Right hand behind your neck. Thread the elbow under, then rotate up as far as you can. Pause briefly at the top.

movements.name: Wall slides with chin nod
movements.cue: Back and head flat on the wall. Slide your arms up and down. As they rise, tuck your chin into a double chin.

movements.name: Prone arm circles
movements.cue: Face down, forehead to the floor. Lift straight arms into a Y and circle them slowly down to your lower back, then back to the Y.

movements.name: Couch stretch · left
movements.cue: Left foot up on a couch or wall, right shin vertical. Squeeze your glutes and tuck your pelvis. Aim for 4 to 5 out of 10.

movements.name: Couch stretch · right
movements.cue: Right foot up behind you. Brace your core, keep the pelvis level. Lean forward to ease off, sit back to go deeper.

movements.name: Pigeon stretch · left
movements.cue: Left leg across a couch or the floor in front, right leg long behind. Brace, then hinge your chest forward over the front leg.

movements.name: Pigeon stretch · right
movements.cue: Right leg in front. Feel it in the outer hip. Spend longer on the side that feels tighter.

movements.name: Glute bridge
movements.cue: On your back, knees bent. Tuck your pelvis, then drive your hips up with your glutes. Hold 5 seconds at the top. Do not arch.
